scenarios.title: Weather
scenarios.prompt: What is the weather in London this weekend?

scenarios.title: Quotes
scenarios.prompt: Compare the two quotes in my documents for 20 school laptops: which is better value and why?

scenarios.title: Deep analysis
scenarios.prompt: Analyse both quotes and the procurement policy, build a short comparison table (at most six rows) and give a recommendation in two or three sentences.

scenarios.title: Image
scenarios.prompt: Draw a picture of a golden autumn park: yellow and orange maple leaves, a wooden bench and an umbrella. No text, no captions, no letters.

scenarios.title: Video
scenarios.prompt: Short video: rain running down a window.

scenarios.title: Photo
scenarios.prompt: What can I cook from the food in the photo? Suggest two simple dishes.

scenarios.title: Timetable
scenarios.prompt: Draft a weekly timetable for Year 7: five school days, six lessons a day, no subject twice in one day.

scenarios.title: Rate
scenarios.prompt: Find the current GBP to EUR rate and work out what a batch of 40 laptops at 899 pounds each costs in euros. Answer in pounds with plain numbers, without formulas.

scenarios.title: Voice
scenarios.prompt: Transcribe this voice message and answer the question in it.

scenarios.title: Album cover
scenarios.prompt: Draw an illustration for the school yearbook: the school yard in autumn and maple leaves. No text, no captions.

scenarios.title: Video task
scenarios.prompt: Make a short video: raindrops on a window.

scenarios.title: Clarification
scenarios.prompt: Make something nice for the school.

scenarios.title: Photo edit
scenarios.prompt: Replace only the background with a sunset sky. Keep everything else unchanged: the same plate of apples and grapes, the same wooden table, the same angle and lighting. Photorealistic, like a real photograph, not a drawing or a stylised picture.

scenarios.title: Fair plan
scenarios.prompt: Draft a five-step plan for the school autumn fair and carry it out in order: schedule, decorations, mailing, equipment, report.

scenarios.title: Document analysis
scenarios.prompt: Analyse both quotes and the procurement policy: name the main risk and give one justified recommendation. Keep it to five sentences and a table of at most six rows.
